claims: The College Basketball Crown (CBC) is a new annual postseason men's basketball tournament.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) was launched in 2025 by FOX Sports and AEG.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) is held in Las Vegas.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) features top-performing teams from the Big Ten, Big 12, Big East conferences that did not qualify for the NCAA Tournament.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) offers a $500,000 NIL prize pool.
The 2026 College Basketball Crown (CBC) tournament features an 8-team, single-elimination format.
The 2026 College Basketball Crown (CBC) tournament is held from April 1–5 in Las Vegas.
Games in the 2026 College Basketball Crown (CBC) tournament are at the T-Mobile Arena and MGM Grand Garden Arena.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) showcases teams from the Big 12, Big Ten, and BIG EAST conferences.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) includes at-large selections that just missed the NCAA Tournament.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) features a $500,000 total prize pool for players.
The Nebraska Cornhuskers won the first College Basketball Crown (CBC) tournament in 2025.
All games of the College Basketball Crown (CBC) are broadcast on FOX and FS1.
